verses.1: In parts according to verses. A Psalm of David.
verses.2: When I called upon him, the God of my justice heeded me. In tribulation, you have enlarged me. Have mercy on me, and heed my prayer.
verses.3: Sons of men, how long will you be dull in heart, so that whatever you love is in vain, and whatever you seek is false?
verses.4: And know this: the Lord has made wondrous his holy one. The Lord will heed me when I cry out to him.
verses.5: Be angry, and do not be willing to sin. The things that you say in your hearts: be sorry for them on your beds.
verses.6: Offer the sacrifice of justice, and hope in the Lord. Many say, “Who reveals to us what is good?”
verses.7: The light of your countenance, Lord, has been sealed upon us. You have given joy to my heart.
verses.8: By the fruit of their grain, wine, and oil, they have been multiplied.
verses.9: In peace itself, I will sleep and I will rest.
verses.10: For you, O Lord, have established me singularly in hope. [ Psalm 5 ]
